prompt: Act as  an Power BI developer and help me solve some questions. I have created a report and my company has preferred theme and color. They have provided color pallet and sample of chart. How can i change that in one go. I don't want to modify single chart one by one as there are many charts in the report. Give me the steps so that i can replicate and complete the report timely.
improvedPrompt:
Act as an expert Power BI Developer specializing in report design, theming, and optimization.

I need a comprehensive, step-by-step guide on how to efficiently apply a specific company-preferred theme and color palette across an entire Power BI report. My goal is to avoid manually modifying the formatting of every individual chart, as the report contains numerous visuals.

I have access to the official company color palette and a sample chart demonstrating the desired visual style.

Please provide the most effective methods and detailed instructions to achieve this bulk theme application in one go. Consider the following:
1. The most efficient technique (e.g., using Themes, Custom Visuals, JSON definitions, or Report Themes).
2. Prerequisites for applying the theme.
3. Detailed steps that I can replicate immediately to ensure the final report reflects the corporate branding accurately and quickly.

Structure your response as an actionable workflow.
